review:
Slots meets match-3 on a 7x7 grid of refilling reels. Five or more touching symbols form a cluster.

There's a lot going on: big symbols double clusters, backlit symbols leave wilds behind, and a Second Chance can save a dead spin. Every winning symbol lowers a counter, and every 25 sets off another feature. Very high volatility, 12,000x max and 96.3% RTP. The forerunner of Pop Zen and Gangsterz.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus is rare (about 1 in 380 spins on average)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
